title: Embedded Software Architect & Technical Lead
description: Get Talent is partnering with an innovative company in the space technology sector to recruit an experienced software leader. Looking to combine embedded software architecture, hands-on technical expertise and team leadership? This role offers the opportunity to shape software for demanding applications where reliability and quality are essential. Your role ▪️ Own the software architecture and guide key technical decisions. ▪️ Lead and mentor a small, growing embedded software team. ▪️ Set development, code review and testing standards. ▪️ Collaborate with hardware, FPGA, control and systems engineers. ▪️ Drive software readiness for qualification, technical audits and customer acceptance. Your background ✔️ A master’s degree in engineering or a relevant scientific discipline. ✔️ Extensive embedded software experience, typically 10+ years, in complex or regulated environments. ✔️ Strong C/C++ expertise on microcontroller-based systems. ✔️ A track record in software architecture and technical leadership in a spatial environment. ✔️ Knowledge of ECSS, DO-178C or comparable development frameworks. ✔️ Strong communication skills in English, with French and/or Dutch. Experience in space applications, FPGA development or automated testing on embedded targets would be an asset. You bring sound technical judgement, a collaborative leadership style and the initiative to thrive in a start-up environment.
industries: Space Research and Technology and Defense and Space Manufacturing
